name: Oren Yomtov
biography: Oren Yomtov (@orenyomtov), Blockchain Research Lead at Fireblocks, is a security researcher with over a decade of experience. In the past year, focusing on the blockchain space, he disclosed a critical vulnerability in a blockchain with a market cap of $100 million and created the first open-source, trustless Bitcoin NFT marketplace, OpenOrdex.
